column1: # GNU DEFVARs a Romacs session leaves unbound: NAME<TAB>STATUS<TAB>NOTE, sorted by name.
# STATUS needed (shipped Lisp reads or sets it: to declare; NOTE says where), elsewhere (in
# progress in another lane; NOTE says which), or absent (deliberately left out; NOTE is the
# reason).  crates/romacs-vm-gui/src/defun_census.rs keeps it exact: a name the world binds
# must leave, a newly unbound DEFVAR must come in.
